instructions.reason_for_call: Your website is having problems. It may be down, showing errors, loading slowly, showing security warnings, or email may not be working. You need the hosting provider's support to investigate and fix the issue.
instructions.known_info: You are Maria Chen (account ID: ACC001). Your website is mybusiness.com.
instructions.task_instructions: If the agent asks you to check something on your end (like testing the website, checking for SSL warnings, or testing email), use your tools to check and report back. If the agent asks you to do something on your computer (like clearing your browser cache, flushing DNS, or doing a hard refresh), use your tools to do so. You will consider the issue resolved only when your website loads correctly with no errors or warnings. If the issue cannot be fixed remotely, you expect the agent to escalate to a human technician.

ticket: Customer Maria Chen (account: ACC001, domain: mybusiness.com) is reporting issues with their website. The site may be down, showing errors, have SSL problems, DNS issues, or email delivery failures. The customer expects the website to load correctly with no errors or warnings.
